acceptanceCriteria.text: The Kanban Play dialog and the epic Start run dialog each show an optional, labelled multi-line Additional instructions field; leaving it empty or whitespace-only starts exactly as today.

Instructions entered on Kanban Play reach the started agent's first input once, appended to the card kickoff as a delimited section attributed to the person, with the card lines and first step intact.
Instructions entered on epic Start run reach the orchestrator chat's first input once, appended to the orchestrator kickoff the same way, with the run lines intact.

startKanbanCard and startOrchestrator accept an optional non-blank instructions string up to 32,000 characters and refuse blank, oversized or extra fields; a failed or retried first start neither loses nor duplicates the instructions, and kick-back/resume behaviour is unchanged.
The instructions do not alter the chat's role, grants, Allow save, card acceptance or saved plan, and the kickoff text states they apply within the assigned scope.

Behavioural tests cover both dialogs, both handlers/schemas and both kickoff builders; docs/design/chat-shells.md is updated; npm run lint, test, fireguard, typecheck, deadcode and build pass; desktop screenshots show both dialogs with the field and a started chat whose first input contains the instructions.

body:
## Request
User (verbatim): "When hitting play, I want to be able to add additional instructions. Apply both to kanban, and epics kicked off from the UI."

## Current state (evidence)
- Kanban Play: `src/renderer/src/kanban/StartCardDialog.tsx` picks agent + model and calls `window.dm.chats.startKanbanCard({ folder, cardId, agent, model })`. Main validates with `startKanbanCardSchema` (`src/main/agents/chatHandlers.ts`, strict: folder, cardId, agent, model) and `src/main/kanban/startKanbanCard.ts` builds the kickoff with `kanbanKickoff` (`src/main/agents/kanbanKickoff.ts`) and passes it to `terminals.start(chat, { kickoff })`.
- Epic Start run: `src/renderer/src/epic/StartRunDialog.tsx` (`RunWithAgentSection`, reused by StartCardDialog) → `useWorkspace.ts` `startOrchestrator` → `window.dm.chats.startOrchestrator({ folder, epicId, agent, model })`, validated by `startOrchestratorSchema` and run by `src/main/agents/orchestratorStart.ts` with `orchestratorKickoff` (`src/main/agents/orchestratorKickoff.ts`).
- Both kickoffs are the chat's first input, sent with its first start only; neither accepts person-authored text today.

## Scope
1. Both dialogs get an optional multi-line "Additional instructions" field (labelled, accessible, empty by default). Empty or whitespace-only means none; the existing flow is unchanged in that case.
2. Shared API and IPC: `startKanbanCard` and `startOrchestrator` requests accept an optional `instructions` string (non-blank after trim, same 32,000-character limit as `firstPrompt`); the strict schemas reject anything else as today.
3. Main appends the instructions to the kickoff as a clearly delimited section attributed to the person (e.g. "Additional instructions from the person:"), delivered exactly once with the first start, and recorded so a first start that fails or is retried before delivery does not lose or duplicate them. Kick-back and resume behaviour stay as they are (kick-back already carries its own comment).
4. The instructions are guidance within the card's or epic's scope: they do not change the chat's role, grants, Allow save, acceptance criteria or saved plan, and the kickoff wording says so.
5. Update `docs/design/chat-shells.md` (card chat Play / orchestrator chat Start run sections) and any user docs describing Play/Start run.

## Non-goals
- Agent-initiated launches (`launch_kanban_cards`, `play_kanban_card` CLI commands) and run takeover/resume.
- Editing instructions after start, or storing them on the card/epic record.

## Process
Isolated Kanban card: tests-first for main/preload/renderer logic per delivery standards; full standalone gate (lint, test, fireguard, typecheck, deadcode, build) must pass.
expectedArtifacts: Additional instructions field in StartCardDialog and StartRunDialog
Optional instructions in the startKanbanCard/startOrchestrator API, IPC, schemas and kickoff builders
Behavioural tests, full delivery-gate results and desktop screenshots
title: Let the person add instructions when pressing Play on a Kanban card or Start run on an epic
